title: Supabase customer stories
description: Customer stories as a 480px row of rounded colour strips: one wide open card (a pink-to-orange gradient here) with the customer's mark, name, a grey tagline and a large white quote with its author at the bottom, beside four narrow dark strips (navy, teal, near-black, blue) showing only their marks. Hovering or focusing a strip smoothly widens it into the open card while the others narrow. Phones stack them: a tall open card over 64px strips.
notes: CSS only: flex-grow transitions on hover and focus-within; the first story is open by default
each strip is a dark scope (the theme's .dark tokens), so it stays dark on a light page; the sunset gradient uses chart-4 → chart-5
the author's portrait is a media slot (round placeholder when empty)
